description: Consensus offers an API for peer-reviewed research search and cited analysis.
auth_notes: Consensus API key sent in an x-api-key header per the OpenAPI; the same key is sent as a Bearer header for MCP.
gate_detail: Public page shows a Create API key button, but an aggregator says enterprise/API access must be requested via a request-access flow. Access path is conflicting, so the stronger prerequisite is assumed.
api_scope: Quick search of papers returning metadata and full-text excerpts, plus an asynchronous Threads endpoint for cited research-agent answers with grounding quotes.
mcp_notes: Consensus publishes connector setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, Gemini and generic MCP clients; no URL stated.
blocker_detail: Third-party listing says enterprise access provides the API key; the Consensus page itself only shows a Create API key button.

evidence.quote: Bring up-to-date, peer-reviewed citations into your workflows.
the OpenAPI for the REST API defines an x-api-key header security scheme.
Request enterprise/API access from Build with the Consensus API using the Request access flow.
Search, synthesize, and build research outputs with cited papers, right inside the AI assistant you already use.

uncertainties: S1 suggests self-serve key creation while S4 says enterprise access is needed.
Sources S5 and S6 describe a different product (Consensus sales demo platform) and were ignored.
MCP server URL, webhooks and sandbox are not stated.
